verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a broad first-party API: payroll and API fundamentals, a full OpenAPI 3.1 spec covering Companies, Flows and other tags, custom reports, and webhooks. However, access is restricted to App Integration and Embedded Payroll partners, and nothing claims or shows that the API covers everything the UI does. Newer UI features such as business formation, banking and compliance services have no documented API coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement or mapping, API coverage of formation/banking/compliance features, API access beyond partners, and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: This site serves as both a technical reference for the endpoints available and a general overview of payroll.
The Gusto Embedded API behavior is built on core fundamentals that apply to every endpoint.
Gusto provides the capability to create custom reports using custom columns, groupings, and optional filters.
